RaggieSoft Training Studio • v0.1.0 .NET 11 Compiler & SCORM 1.2 / 2004 Runtime

Bandwidth-Proof WCAG 2.2 AA Compliance Courseware — Zero 400 MB MP4 Stalls.

Born from rescuing a 14-slide municipal ADA Title II training module that baked static slides into 400+ MB progressive .mp4 files and stalled across congested enterprise WAN proxies, RaggieSoft Training Studio (rstbuild) compiles Git-diffable .rstp manifests, Markdown slides, compact 48 kbps Opus / AAC voiceovers, and verified .vtt captions into self-contained SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 (4th Ed.) packages (<50 KB player) with an automatic HTML5 VPAT 2.5 report in the box.
